verdict: Lead cost spiked this week; creative fatigue and an intake gap are being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 89 leads from Meta at an average cost of $23.33 per lead, but the last 7 days showed a sharp deterioration: leads dropped 34.62% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat, pushing cost per lead up 45.82%. The most likely cause is audience fatigue on the primary campaign, which has been running unchanged since March — ad creative is being refreshed this week to stabilize efficiency. Separately, your Google Business Profile went effectively dark for 6 consecutive days at the end of July, cutting off an organic visibility channel that had been averaging roughly 6 actions per day; that issue is being investigated now. On the intake side, 89 leads entered the system this period but none were converted into pipeline opportunities, which means some leads are not being followed up — that gap is being reviewed so you stop losing leads after they arrive.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, entirely through Meta paid ads
average cost per lead over the last 28 days
rise in cost per lead over the past 7 days, driven by fewer leads at near-flat spend

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead is rising as the primary Meta campaign shows classic creative fatigue, and Google Business Profile actions dropped to zero for six straight days.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week and the GBP visibility drop is under active investigation — both actions are already in motion.
